title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water.
Beat the eggs and mix with cheese.
Drain the pasta and mix everything together off the heat.
Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in tikka masala paste and grill until cooked.
Add tomato puree and cook for 10 minutes.
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve with rice.
